notes:
Faster to open. The app was asking the server for about twenty things the moment it started, and a phone only runs five at a time — so the home screen sat waiting on a queue. It now asks for the top of the screen first and paints that immediately, fills the rest in behind it, and the unread badges ask for their four numbers instead of downloading whole lists of notifications and conversations to count them.

Interviews are a proper write-up now. An interviewer records a rating per competency, the strengths, the concerns for the next round to probe, a recommendation and their overall remarks — and, above all of that, they open the round already holding what the EARLIER rounds found. A CEO or MD assigned to a round reads and records it under My Interviews in the admin section, which they did not have before.

Loans and advances speak up. A request tells whoever decides them; the decision, the disbursement and every repayment tell the borrower, with what is still outstanding. Deciding loans can now be given to anyone — an accounts person, not only HR — and they get the queue in their own portal.

A task can be given to everybody at once: pick "All employees" as the assignee and each person gets their own copy to complete.

Boys Incentive: the non-rolling share is one group for the DAY, chosen from the people who did not roll. 70% of everything rolled that day stays with the teams that rolled it and the remaining 30% is split equally between that group.
